definition.winner: all arms tied for the minimum absolute error; ties are retained
definition.pairwise_reversal: within one video, each arm has lower absolute error than the other on at least one retained protocol cell

common_grid_sensitivity.role: coverage-unfiltered sensitivity only; it fixes all six videos at each literal L x tau point but includes low-coverage windows
common_grid_sensitivity.valid_rule: tau <= L/2 and G(L) > 0; no coverage threshold
